revision: WORLD 1 v12d 2026-09-02: areas a1-a30 rebuilt from MVW_World1_Level_Design_V12d.xlsx. The sheet is the design: fence, cover, gates, robot counts, robot positions, sheds and bosses are all what is drawn. A shed or boss the sheet does not draw does not exist. Cover cells the drawing places inside a shed spawn ring, a mobile shed's 7 m clearance, a boss's 12 m clear radius or 2 m of a doorway are removed cell-by-cell, and robots inside the 1 m cover gap or a shed ring are nudged the minimum distance - those are MapValidation load gates, not design choices.
note: Authored in-chat to trial the World & Difficulty Framework (Confluence MVW 34439170). enemyTypes.thv were relative placeholders (1.0/2.5/4.5/7.0) at LOCK time; MV-270 replaced them with values derived from EnemyArchetype's real hp/contact-damage/speed via THV=(hp+shield)*dps*speedFactor*archetypeWeight (shield=0, archetypeWeight=1, dps=contactDamage/attackCycle) then scaled by x1.2 so R=MPL/EPL (PowerScoring) lands in the 0.85-1.4 band against the Water Blaster's real per-level DPS across Areas 1-7 — see World1CalibrationTests. The derived shape (1.0 : 2.6 : 4.49 : 7.11) came out almost identical to the original placeholder ratio, so the curve's SHAPE stood; only the magnitude moved.

areas.name: Area 1 - The Carport
areas.notes: MV-479 pilot: cover only. The lobby, the entry doorway g0 and the east gate g1 to Area 2 are all untouched. Because the two gates sit on adjacent walls (south and east), the cover is what stops the south-east corner cut: the hedge island and its arm seal the east side low down, so the room has to be crossed westward and back. Walkable route entry->exit is 27.1 m against a 32.6 m diagonal (83%), up from 22.1 m (68%) - the five shipped hedges scored the same as an empty room. Depth 24 m and the composition are unchanged from MV-442.

areas.name: Area 2
areas.notes: MV-479 series: cover only. No gate, origin, size, composition or dial changed. Entry (W wall) and exit (N wall) are adjacent, so the cover is what stops the corner cut: walkable route entry->exit is now 31.9 m against a 31.2 m diagonal (102%), up from 15.1 m (48%). Cover is held clear of the 4 Garrison.SeedPositions points, which the engine places blind to cover. | Designer instruction: the 4 Blinkers stand in TWO PAIRS in the east half, away from the west entry gate. Authored via area.garrison[] (MV-559).

areas.name: Area 3 - The Shed
areas.notes: MV-479 series: cover only. No gate, origin, size, composition or dial changed. Entry (S wall) and exit (W wall) are adjacent, so the cover is what stops the corner cut: walkable route entry->exit is now 31.2 m against a 30.0 m diagonal (104%), up from 15.1 m (50%). Cover is held clear of the 5 Garrison.SeedPositions points and of the shed spawn ring, which the engine places blind to cover. Lee's workbook edit 2026-08-20: gunners cut 3 -> 2.

areas.name: Area 4
areas.notes: Lee's workbook edit 2026-08-20: added an L-shaped hedge in the west of the room and repositioned three gunners. Gate g4 moved 9 m west to x=-11 (drawn on a5's south wall; a4's north end propagated to match so both ends resolve to the same point). The L's vertical arm was trimmed 1 m at the top: as drawn it sat 1.4 m from the relocated g4 mouth, under MapValidation.DoorwayClearance 2 m.

areas.name: Area 5
areas.notes: Lee's workbook edit 2026-08-20: bombers cut 4 -> 1. Both of this area's gates were repositioned on a5's own walls (south to x=-11, east to z=69.5); the neighbours' ends were propagated to match so no gate has disagreeing endpoints. | scenario 'centerDenial' dropped: it biases Launcher spawns and this area's authored composition has none.

areas.name: Area 6 - The Greenhouse
areas.notes: Lee's workbook edit 2026-08-20: added a hedge across the north of the room, which merged with the existing piece at x 32..34 into one 10 m run. Shifted 1 m north (z 67..68 -> 68..69): as drawn it overlapped the shed's spawn ring (SpawnRadius 3.5 + SpawnClearance 0.8) by 0.3 m and MapValidation would have rejected the map. a6_h5 was trimmed at its south end (z 68..71 -> 69..71) so it abuts the shifted run instead of intersecting it. Gate g6 moved 12.4 m east to x=37.5 (drawn on a6's north wall; a7's south end propagated to match). NOTE: 2 of this area's 7 Garrison.SeedPositions points fall inside this hedge - the engine seeds blind to cover. Tracked separately. | Bolter pass 2026-08-25: 2 bolters - introduction: the most broken-up of the mid rooms (48% clear sightlines) and the one with the best hedge line, so 'break line of sight' is the visible answer the first time you meet it.

Needs MV-475.
